about: The gradual of the Second Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 49. The chant between the readings: the first half says where God comes from, the second calls for the gathering of those who made His covenant.

s01.translation: From Sion, the splendor of His beauty: God will come openly.

translation_citations.title: The Missal for the Laity (1846)
translation_citations.locator: parallel Ordinary and Advent propers, examined edition

s02.translation: Gather to Him His saints, who have set His covenant upon sacrifices.
